output.explanation: Returns the registered mean components for all S1 enrollments, including all offerings and retakes. NULL grades are excluded from graded_count but included in enrollment_count; no mean division is performed.
output.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.grade_units),0) AS sum_units, COUNT(e.grade_units) AS graded_count, COUNT(*) AS enrollment_count FROM Enrollments e JOIN Offerings o ON e.offering_id=o.offering_id WHERE o.semester_id = :semester_id
